geographyNote: City of St. Thomas, Ontario (census subdivision)

facts.text: Volkswagen is investing $7 billion in an electric vehicle battery plant in St. Thomas that will create up to 3,000 direct jobs.
facts.evidence: Volkswagen is investing $7 billion to establish its first overseas electric vehicle battery manufacturing plant in St. Thomas, Ontario ... The plant will create up to 3,000 direct jobs and up to 30,000 indirect jobs.

facts.text: The Volkswagen battery plant in St. Thomas is designed to produce batteries for up to one million electric vehicles per year.
facts.evidence: Once complete in 2027, the plant will produce batteries for up to one million electric vehicles per year.

facts.text: St. Thomas Elgin General Hospital is one of the area's largest employers, with over 1,000 staff and 230 physicians.
facts.publisher: St. Thomas & District Chamber of Commerce
facts.evidence: as one of the area's largest employers, they have over 1,000 staff, 230 physicians (including dentists and midwives) and almost 100 volunteers.

facts.text: The St. Thomas Economic Development Corporation, established in 1957, works to attract, retain and grow industrial business and tourism in the city.
facts.evidence: The EDC's mission is to enhance the quality of life for all citizens of St. Thomas by attracting, retaining and growing industrial business and tourism sectors ... Established in 1957

meta.descriptor: a growing city in Elgin County, south of London
meta.fact: the site of Volkswagen's $7-billion electric vehicle battery plant

overview: St. Thomas had 42,840 residents in 2021, up 10.1% from 38,909 in 2016, in 18,062 occupied private dwellings packed into just 35.61 square kilometres. A compact, quickly growing city means short drives and a lot of new households choosing businesses for the first time.

A large electric vehicle battery plant is set to add thousands of jobs, which should bring more workers, more housing and more competition. Local firms that build visibility now will be easier to find as the city grows.

byService.lead-generation: With St. Thomas growing 10.1% since 2016 and a major battery plant hiring, lead generation should focus on newcomers and trades demand tied to new housing and industrial construction.
byService.seo: As outside companies arrive with the battery plant, local SEO in St. Thomas becomes more contested, so claiming city and neighbourhood search terms early is worth the effort.
byService.website-development: A compact city of 35.61 square kilometres rewards websites that make location, hours and quick contact obvious, because most customers can reach you within minutes.
byService.branding: Branding in St. Thomas can lean on the city's railway heritage and close-knit feel while showing that a business is ready to serve a larger, more industrial community.
